title: agent-worker: consolidate its requirements under the cap, then answer its provider notices
prior_work: First, consolidate build/requirements/agent-worker.md (91906 bytes) under the requirements cap (70000): move non-requirement text (status history, rulings, cross-references, commentary) to docs/requirements-notes/agent-worker.md, which this job owns, and keep every **R<n>** and **F<n>** line and its mark verbatim; add a test under this module's tests that asserts the set of requirement ids and unmet marks in build/requirements/agent-worker.md is unchanged by the move (compare against the ids at the start commit). Then do the provider-notice work this START lists: for each notice, decide from your own requirements what this module must do, adapt or confirm, and add a test of your own for the change, failing with it reverted where code changes. Only if consolidation cannot get the file under the cap, stop and report to BOB with a split proposal (new module ids, build/modules.json rows, build/layers.md). Edit no other module, and commit no generated file (rows.mjs, words-unreviewed.json, any dist). Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead.

status.reason: Consolidation cannot get build/requirements/agent-worker.md under the 70000-byte cap while keeping every R/F line verbatim. Measured at the start commit: the 128 R lines and the F1 line alone are 68,341 bytes. Live requirement text that is not an R line but must stay with it adds 2,086 bytes (the sub-bullets of R86, R87 and R89: shapes, refusals, tests), plus 713 bytes of definitions R1-R8 rest on (the Terms paragraph and the POST /run body line), plus the title. Floor: about 71,170 bytes, before any heading, even with all status history, the old/new table, Size, Uses, Satisfies, Suggestions and Open for Bob moved to notes. Nothing was changed on the branch, and the provider notices (run-rules:72, credentials:74) were not started. SPLIT PROPOSAL: (1) new module agent-drafts takes POST /draft: R59, R68, R69, R70, R76, R77, R86 (12,217 bytes with R86's bullets), renumbered there, retired here as 'moved to agent-drafts Rn'. agent-worker then lands at about 61 KB with its headings, and agent-drafts at about 13 KB. (2) build/modules.json row: {"id": "agent-drafts", "layer": 6, "paths": [], "tests": [], "uses": ["run-rules", "agent-model", "agent-harness", "agent-steps", "skills", "answers", "setup-words", "test-support"]}, empty paths and tests until its job's merge (K1043), split by copy (K624, no from) of agent-worker/src/draft.mjs, action-drafts.mjs and untested.mjs. agent-worker adds agent-drafts to its uses. (3) build/layers.md layer 6 order: ..., agent-steps, agent-runner, agent-drafts, agent-worker, ai-gate. Open point for BOB: draft.mjs imports admitRead, readTool and ASK_DECLARED from ask.mjs, doorTrace from signin.mjs and remoteOf from remote.mjs. Either those helpers move into agent-drafts and agent-worker imports them from there, or agent-drafts goes after agent-worker and /draft is routed through a host seam. I recommend the first (signin.mjs and remote.mjs are being retired into agent-model's adapter under T53 anyway). An alternative or extra split is agent-transcribe (R72-R75, 6,063 bytes), but that alone would not reach the cap. Restart this job after the split to consolidate and answer the notices.
